content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-works-how|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-digital-products-every-detail-you-2|Tron USDT]]-digital-products-what-actually-how-5|payments]], Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

This is a sovereign commerce stack. It’s a combination of free tools that handle hosting, payment, and delivery without relying on third-party platforms. You own the code. You own the data. You own the customer relationship. It’s built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or restrictive. Instead of renting infrastructure, you deploy your own. The core function: a buyer pays in crypto, the system verifies the payment on-chain, and delivers the ebook automatically. No manual intervention. No platform fees. Just your product, your rules, your revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting (free). Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free). Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets (free). Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). Payment is processed through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee. When a buyer sends payment, NOWPayments verifies it on-chain and triggers a webhook. The webhook fires a script that checks the payment status, retrieves the ebook from storage, and sends a secure download link to the buyer’s email. The entire process is automated and runs without human intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or restrictive. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, or the Philippines, this is for you. If you’re tired of platforms taking 10% per sale (like Gumroad), this is for you. If you want to accept crypto payments without KYC or buyer accounts, this is for you. It’s for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. Who want to control their data, not hand it over. Who want to build a business that can’t be shut down by a platform’s terms of service.
Gumroad takes 10% per sale. NOWPayments takes 0.5%. At 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores your ebook files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments and triggers webhooks. The webhook integrates with your backend script to verify payment and deliver the ebook. Each component is free or low-cost. Each component is replaceable. Each component is under your control. The system is modular. If one part fails, you replace it without disrupting the whole stack. This is infrastructure sovereignty.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) if you’re new to this. It deploys in 48 hours, includes GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments, and loads 3 products. Upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, 5 products, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. If you want to build it yourself, get the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Deploy on your own domain. Test end-to-end. Launch. The system runs itself. You focus on creating. Not on fighting platforms. Not on currency collapse. Not on financial isolation.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Sell your ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign commerce stack. Host your storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Process payments with NOWPayments (0.5% fee). Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automate the entire process with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This eliminates platform fees, gives you full data ownership, and lets you accept crypto payments from anyone, anywhere.
Your infrastructure. Your rules. No platform can shut you down.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, or digital downloads without platform fees, this same architecture applies. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to deploy any digital product type. Instant download. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. Build your stack at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and start selling on your terms.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this to sell fonts and templates?
Yes. The same architecture works for any digital product. Replace the ebook file with your font or template file. The delivery script retrieves the correct file based on the product purchased.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept?
Accept stablecoins like USDT or USDC for price stability. Add Bitcoin or Ethereum for broader adoption. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks for low transaction fees (under $0.10 per transaction).
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are handled manually. Since you own the infrastructure, you can reverse the transaction directly with the buyer. Document your refund policy clearly on your storefront.
Can I scale this to thousands of sales?
Yes. The stack is built on scalable components. Upgrade to paid tiers of Supabase, Cloudflare R2, or NOWPayments as needed. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook.
What if NOWPayments goes down?
If NOWPayments fails, replace it with another crypto payment processor. The system is modular. You own the code. You control the integration. Downtime is minimized.
Built in Zimbabwe. Pressure-tested against currency collapse and financial isolation.
